name: Jamie Wasserman
description: Jamie Wasserman, Office Manager & Customer Support: Jamie Wasserman helps keep Alpha-Plumbing Services running smoothly behind the scenes. As the office manager and customer-support contact, she assists customers with scheduling, estimates, appointment coordination, service questions, and follow-up communication. Jamie is committed to providing a friendly, responsive experience from the first call through project completion. As part of the family-owned Alpha-Plumbing Services team, she helps ensure every customer receives clear communication and dependable support.
